authenticity_review: The image exhibits high visual fidelity in terms of lighting, texture sharpness, and composition, resembling a professional studio photograph. However, significant structural artifacts reduce authenticity. The hands/fingers resting on the ledge show malformations: digits appear fused, have incorrect counts, or lack clear separation (syndactyly/polydactyly), particularly on the central monkeys. Additionally, the ears are disproportionately large and stylized compared to realistic guenon anatomy, and tails are largely absent or obscured. These anatomical inaccuracies indicate AI generation despite the photorealistic surface quality.
key_defects: Malformed fingers/hands with fusion or incorrect digit counts
Disproportionately large, stylized ears inconsistent with guenon taxonomy
Missing or obscured tails (non-prehensile tail checkpoint failed)
Lack of distinctive facial ruff (clean-shaven faces)
